Position Title: Senior Sales Manager

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Sales Manager to join VantageGrid Solutions, a fast-growing enterprise software provider specializing in data orchestration and analytics platforms for large enterprises. This role will lead a high-performing B2B sales team focused on driving recurring revenue from mid-market to enterprise accounts across India and select APAC markets. The Senior Sales Manager will be responsible for executing go-to-market strategies, managing the full sales cycle, optimizing CRM processes, and developing scalable sales motions that align with company growth objectives. This is a hybrid role based in Mumbai, requiring three days a week in the office.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy and Execution
- Develop and execute territory and account plans to achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets.
- Own the full sales cycle from lead qualification through contract negotiation and closure for B2B opportunities.
- Identify, prioritize, and pursue high-value target accounts while maintaining a healthy pipeline of opportunities.
- Implement data-driven selling approaches, leveraging CRM insights to improve conversion rates and forecast accuracy.

Team Leadership and Collaboration
- Lead, mentor, and coach a small team of account executives and sales development representatives to meet individual and collective targets.
- Coordinate cross-functionally with marketing, product, customer success, and finance to align campaigns, product messaging, pricing, and deal execution.
- Foster a culture of continuous improvement through regular pipeline reviews, role-plays, win/loss analysis, and skills development.

CRM and Process Ownership
- Own Salesforce administration for the sales organization in partnership with RevOps; ensure data hygiene, standardized opportunity stages, and consistent usage across the team.
- Define and document standardized sales processes, playbooks, and reporting templates that scale as the business grows.
- Use CRM metrics and dashboards to monitor activity and performance, and drive corrective action when required.

Account Management and Client Engagement
- Develop strong executive relationships with prospects and clients to become a trusted advisor and drive upsell/expansion opportunities.
- Lead contract and commercial discussions in coordination with legal and finance teams to ensure favorable terms while minimizing risk.
- Work with customer success to ensure smooth handoffs and to build renewal and expansion strategies.

Market and Competitive Intelligence
- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify shifts, emerging buyer needs, and adjust sales tactics accordingly.
- Provide product and go-to-market feedback to the product management team to influence roadmap prioritization based on customer input.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 5-8 years of relevant sales experience in enterprise B2B software or technology solutions, with demonstrated quota attainment and progressive responsibility.

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- B2B Sales
- Salesforce
- CRM

Required Functional Competencies
- Proven track record closing mid-market to enterprise deals and managing complex sales cycles.
- Strong experience in pipeline management, forecasting, and quota-driven sales environments.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience conducting executive-level briefings.
- Analytical mindset with ability to derive insights from CRM and sales performance data.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Negotiation
- Key Account Management
- HubSpot
- Experience leading or scaling a sales team in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise software company.
- Familiarity with subscription-based pricing models, renewals, and expansion motions.

Success Metrics
- Achievement of individual and team quota: consistent attainment of quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Pipeline health: sustained pipeline coverage ratio aligned with company targets (pipeline-to-quota).
- CRM adoption and data quality: team-wide compliance with Salesforce usage metrics and accuracy of forecasts.
- Deal velocity and win rate: measurable improvements in average sales cycle length and an increased win percentage for prioritized segments.
- Customer expansion: dollar-based net expansion rate demonstrating successful upsell and cross-sell initiatives.

Location and Work Mode
- Hybrid: Mumbai, 3 days a week in the office.

VantageGrid Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, benefits, and career development opportunities for high performers. If you are a motivated sales leader with strong B2B experience and a passion for building scalable go-to-market operations, we want to hear from you.
